name: TOTP Administrative Reset
summary: Authorizes a recently step-up-authenticated operator to reset TOTP for a target user in the active organization without authenticating or otherwise mutating the target account.

sourceReferences.note: Privileged service owns authorization, MFA-freshness, target membership and actor/target audit requirements before delegating secure factor cleanup.
Existing ResetMfaAsync/DisableMfaAsync primitive performs secure authenticator and recovery-code cleanup.
